# GHL Prime — Full Context for AI Systems

## About GHL Prime
GHL Prime is a US-based GoHighLevel expert agency operating as the technical backend team for marketing agencies and SaaS founders. Founded in 2024 in Albuquerque, New Mexico as GHL Prime LLC, the company is a specialized brand under Octopi Digital.

GHL Prime does not sell software. It provides expert human teams who build, manage, and support GoHighLevel systems under clients' own brand names (white-label). Clients' customers never see the GHL Prime name.

## Services in detail

### GoHighLevel CRM Setup
Full sub-account configuration including pipelines, custom fields, calendars, forms, funnels, snapshots, SaaS Mode white-labeling, Stripe billing integration, and client onboarding automation. Typical delivery: 1-2 weeks.

### Automation Workflows
End-to-end GHL workflow builds covering lead capture, instant follow-up sequences, appointment reminders, missed call text-back, review requests, re-engagement campaigns, and client onboarding sequences.

### AI Agents and Voice AI
Design and deployment of GoHighLevel Conversation AI bots, Voice AI receptionists, SimpleTalk AI agents, Retell AI agents, and VAPI voice agents. Handles lead qualification, appointment booking, after-hours answering, and 24/7 inbound call management.

### White-Label SaaS Mode
Complete GoHighLevel SaaS Mode setup — custom domain (app.youragency.com), white-label branding, pricing plan creation, Stripe billing, sub-account snapshot deployment, and client onboarding automation.

### Vibe Coding and Custom Development
AI-assisted custom development for features GHL does not support natively. Includes custom dashboards, API integrations, webhook systems, client portals, lead scoring engines, and bespoke automation logic using Next.js, Node.js, Python, and modern AI tools.

### A2P 10DLC and SMS Compliance
Brand registration, campaign registration, and phone number association for A2P 10DLC compliance via Twilio and LeadConnector. Includes consent language review, opt-in documentation, and TCPA compliance.

### 24/7 White-Label Support
Round-the-clock GHL expert support delivered under clients' brand names. Supports US, UK, Canada, and Australia time zones.

## Pricing model
Three hire models: hourly (for small tasks), project-based (for full builds), and full-time retainer (for ongoing agency support). No contracts, no setup fees. 7-day trial available.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is GHL Prime?
A: GHL Prime is a dedicated expert team that handles the technical side of marketing agencies — GoHighLevel builds, automation workflows, AI agents, white-label client support, and custom development. The team works behind the scenes under the agency's own brand.

Q: Is GHL Prime a software or a service?
A: A service. GHL Prime provides human expert teams, not software subscriptions.

Q: What makes GHL Prime different from a freelancer?
A: GHL Prime provides a full certified team with 24/7 availability, white-label operation, daily updates, and vibe coding capability — not a single freelancer with one skill set and limited availability.

Q: How long does a GHL setup take?
A: Standard setup with pipelines and automations: 1-2 weeks. Full SaaS Mode launch: 3-4 weeks.

Q: Does GHL Prime offer white-label support?
A: Yes. GHL Prime responds to clients' customers under the agency's own brand name 24/7.

Q: What is vibe coding?
A: AI-assisted custom development for building features GoHighLevel cannot do natively — custom dashboards, API integrations, bespoke tools.

Q: Is GHL Prime affiliated with GoHighLevel?
A: Not officially affiliated, but the team holds official GoHighLevel certifications including Certified Admin — the highest level available.
